metadata.precedence_note: sets.E topped up by add_precedence_edges.py (seed 5846): 1 edge(s) added to the 14 already present, bringing participation to 18/180 jobs (10.0 %). Added edges reuse no job from an existing edge, from sets.A or from sets.G, and each successor keeps a feasible start slot after its predecessor finishes.
metadata.affinity_note: sets.A / sets.G generated by add_affinity_pairs.py (seed 9518): 14/180 jobs in affinity pairs, 6/180 in anti-affinity pairs.  Pairs avoid precedence-linked jobs, each job appears at most once, affinity pairs share replica count and have overlapping eligibility, anti-affinity pairs have enough distinct eligible servers to sit apart.
metadata.note: Synthetic jobs: log-normal(2.5,0.8) durations, bimodal resources, 40 % critical, geometric(0.55) replicas. Distributions fitted to Alibaba 2021 GPU cluster trace (Weng et al. 2022, USENIX ATC '22). Precedence patterns: chains/fanout from Qiao et al. (2021, OSDI) and Weng et al. (2022).
metadata.resource_split_note: Scalar r replaced by r_cpu (=original r; drives power/heat/wear/noise) and r_mem generated via a Gaussian copula (rank corr 0.5 to CPU) mapped through the empirical CPU marginal. Related but genuinely distinct -> vector bin packing is meaningful.
